name: Easton Point Park
blurb: Quiet riverside park in Easton with water views, dock access, and walking paths. Dogs allowed.

name: Patapsco Valley State Park
blurb: Sprawling state park along the Patapsco River with miles of trails.

name: Cunningham Falls
blurb: Maryland's largest cascading waterfall, 78 ft drop in Catoctin Mountain Park.

name: Billy Goat Trail
blurb: Rugged rock-scramble trail along the Potomac River near Great Falls.

name: Great Falls Park
blurb: Dramatic Potomac River waterfalls and gorge on the Virginia side.

name: Shenandoah National Park
blurb: Blue Ridge Mountains with Skyline Drive, 500+ miles of trails, and wildlife.

name: Gunpowder Falls State Park
blurb: Long river corridor park north of Baltimore with swimming holes and trails.

name: Calvert Cliffs State Park
blurb: Chesapeake Bay fossil cliffs — find shark teeth on the beach.

name: Sugarloaf Mountain
blurb: Isolated monadnock rising 800 ft above the Piedmont, great summit views.

name: Annapolis Rock AT
blurb: Appalachian Trail overlook with sweeping views of Middletown Valley.

name: Seneca Creek State Park
blurb: 6,300-acre park following Seneca Creek with lake, trails, and canoe access.

name: Sandy Point State Park
blurb: Beach on the Chesapeake Bay with sweeping views of the Bay Bridge.

name: Assateague Island
blurb: Barrier island with wild ponies, pristine beaches, and undeveloped seashore.

name: Rock Creek Park
blurb: Urban national park running through DC with forested trails and creek.

name: C&O Canal Towpath
blurb: 184.5-mile flat towpath from DC to Cumberland along the Potomac River. This pin is the Great Falls Tavern access in Potomac, MD.

name: Blackwater National Wildlife Refuge
blurb: Tidal marsh refuge on the Eastern Shore — eagles, migratory birds, eerie tidelands.

name: Maryland Heights Trail
blurb: Steep, demanding climb above Harpers Ferry — at the top the Shenandoah and Potomac rivers meet 1,000 ft below you, with the village and Blue Ridge stretching in every direction. One of the best views on the East Coast.

name: Merkle Wildlife Sanctuary
blurb: Scenic sanctuary along the Patuxent River; fall Canada goose flocks number in the thousands.

name: Jug Bay Wetlands Sanctuary
blurb: Pristine tidal freshwater wetland on the Patuxent River — kayaking and birding.

name: Rocks State Park
blurb: Dramatic rock outcrops in the Deer Creek valley, including the King and Queen Seat.

name: Catoctin Mountain Park
blurb: Federal park adjacent to Camp David with rugged trails and Blue Blazes Whiskey Still.

name: South Mountain State Park
blurb: AT corridor and Civil War battlefield ridge with long mountain views.

name: Prettyboy Reservoir
blurb: Remote reservoir north of Baltimore — quiet trails and undeveloped shoreline.

name: Soldier's Delight Natural Area
blurb: Rare serpentine barrens with alien-looking landscape and endemic plant species.

name: Edgar Allan Poe House
blurb: The poet's childhood Baltimore home, now a small museum in the Poe neighborhood.

name: National Harbor
blurb: Waterfront development on the Potomac with sweeping river views and the Awakening statue.

name: Chesapeake Bay Bridge Viewpoint
blurb: Sandy Point beach gives the best ground-level view of the twin Bay Bridge spans.

name: Point Lookout State Park
blurb: Where the Potomac meets the Bay — Civil War prison site, lighthouse, and ghost lore.

name: Sky Meadows State Park
blurb: Rolling Virginia piedmont farm with meadow trails and Blue Ridge backdrop.

name: Cunningham Falls Manor Area
blurb: Lower section of Cunningham Falls SP with Hunting Creek Lake and fishing.

name: Pot Rocks
blurb: Natural swimming hole on the Gunpowder River with massive boulders and clear water. Local hidden gem in Kingsville MD.

name: Dolly Sods Wilderness
blurb: High-elevation plateau wilderness in WV — wind-sculpted spruce, red bogs, and sweeping heath barrens unlike anywhere else in the region.

name: Winkler Botanical Preserve
blurb: Hidden 44-acre nature preserve in Alexandria VA — woodland trails, waterfall, and native plant gardens tucked between suburbia.

name: Natural Tunnel State Park
blurb: A 900-ft natural tunnel blasted through solid limestone by a creek — Daniel Boone called it the 8th wonder of the world. Worth the drive.

name: Prettyboy Dam
blurb: Massive stone dam holding back Prettyboy Reservoir — dramatic overlook with the spillway roaring below. Historical landmark.

name: Gambrill State Park
blurb: Wooded ridgeline park above Frederick MD with overlooks stretching across the valley. Great trail network and rock outcrops.

name: Bear Rocks Preserve
blurb: Wind-battered quartzite boulders on the Allegheny Front in WV — red spruce, 360° ridge views, and a sense of total wildness. Adjacent to Dolly Sods.

name: High Rock
blurb: AT scenic spot near Pen Mar MD — graffiti-covered boulders at the ridge edge with a massive 180° view over the Cumberland Valley.

name: Robinson Nature Center
blurb: Tucked-away nature preserve in Columbia MD with wetland boardwalks, meadow trails, and wildlife viewing.

name: Fort Smallwood Park
blurb: Waterfront Anne Arundel park right on the Patapsco River mouth — sweeping Bay views, beach, fishing pier, and trails. Very close to Pasadena.

name: Wildflower Trail
blurb: Wooded trail in Kinder Farm Park in Millersville, off the park's paved loop. It links with the Blackberry and Bunks Pond trails.

name: Severn Run Natural Environment Area
blurb: Forested stream valley in Anne Arundel County following Severn Run — quiet trails, wetlands, and total seclusion close to Pasadena.

name: The Magothy Greenway Natural Area
blurb: Preserved natural corridor along the Magothy River near Pasadena — wooded paths, creek crossings, and tidal marsh views. Practically in your backyard.

name: White Cliffs of Conoy
blurb: Dramatic white limestone cliffs dropping straight into the Susquehanna River in PA — looks like something from another continent. Hidden hiking area.

name: Franciscan Monastery of the Holy Land
blurb: Full-scale replicas of Jerusalem shrines and Roman catacombs hidden inside a DC monastery — one of the most surreal places in the region.

name: Crystal Grottoes Caverns
blurb: Maryland's only publicly accessible cave — stalactites, stalagmites, and crystal formations packed into a small limestone cave near Boonsboro. Completely unexpected.

name: Paw Paw Tunnel
blurb: 3,118-ft hand-dug canal tunnel from 1850 — you walk straight through a mountain in pitch darkness on the C&O Canal towpath. Nothing else like it on the East Coast.

name: Sideling Hill Road Cut
blurb: 340-million-year-old rock layers folded into a massive syncline exposed when I-68 was blasted through the mountain. Free exhibit at the top. Geology visible from the highway.

name: Gathland State Park
blurb: A 19th-century journalist built a castle estate on South Mountain, then died broke. The ruins remain — arches, towers, outbuildings — plus the only monument to war correspondents in the US.

name: Battle Creek Cypress Swamp
blurb: Northernmost natural bald cypress swamp in the US — ancient trees draped in moss, boardwalk over black water, feels like the deep South dropped into Calvert County MD.

name: Seneca Rocks
blurb: Near-vertical quartzite fins rising 900 ft straight out of a flat WV valley floor — looks fake. Rock climbing mecca and one of the most dramatic landscapes in the mid-Atlantic.

name: Old Rag Mountain
blurb: The crown jewel scramble of Shenandoah — 9-mile circuit with a mile of pure boulder maze at the summit. Most sought-after day hike in VA.

name: Smoke Hole Canyon
blurb: The South Branch Potomac carved a deep gorge through WV limestone — narrow canyon walls, cave entrances, and river so clear you can count the rocks on the bottom.

name: Weverton Cliffs
blurb: Short but steep AT climb to a dramatic rocky perch above the Potomac gorge and Harpers Ferry gap — the view is massive and the hike takes under an hour.

name: Roaches Run Waterfowl Sanctuary
blurb: A hidden tidal marsh full of herons and ducks sitting directly beneath Reagan Airport's flight path — planes roar 200 ft overhead while egrets fish below. Surreal.

name: Swallow Falls State Park
blurb: Maryland's most spectacular waterfall cluster — multiple falls including 53-ft Muddy Creek Falls crashing through an old-growth hemlock gorge near Deep Creek Lake.

name: Beverly-Triton Beach Park
blurb: Small quiet beach park in Shady Side MD on the Bay — grassy picnic area, sandy beach, calm water. Perfect for reading or a slow afternoon.

name: Quiet Waters Park
blurb: Annapolis park with 6 miles of paved trails on the South River — popular running loop with water views, benches, and shaded paths. Dogs welcome.

name: Scott's Run Nature Preserve
blurb: McLean VA preserve with a waterfall tumbling into the Potomac River — rocky scramble down to the falls, swimming when water is up, and dramatic river views. One of the best quick escapes near DC.

name: Flag Ponds Nature Park
blurb: Hidden Calvert County beach park — mile-long trail through forest opens onto a secluded Chesapeake Bay beach with fossil cliffs. Fewer crowds than Calvert Cliffs but same magic.

name: Piney Orchard Nature Preserve
blurb: Forested nature preserve in Odenton with winding trails through wetlands and woods — great for a run or a quiet walk away from the suburbs. Hidden local favorite.

name: Lake Waterford Park
blurb: Small lake park in Pasadena — paved loop around the lake, good for a run or a quiet walk. Ducks, fishing, benches by the water. A real local gem.

name: Kinder Farm Park
blurb: Millersville MD park with a 2.5-mile paved loop — great flat run through open farmland and forest. Peaceful and rarely crowded.

name: North Beach Town Beach
blurb: Small Chesapeake Bay beach town with a public boardwalk and sandy beach — good sunset spot, vintage feel, easy drive south from Pasadena.

name: Downs Park
blurb: Pasadena waterfront county park on the Chesapeake Bay — beach, wooded trails, fishing pier, and wide water views. One of the best local parks in Anne Arundel County.

name: Terrapin Nature Park
blurb: Kent Island waterfront park right on the Chesapeake Bay — sandy beach, marsh trails, and a front-row view of the Bay Bridge. Easy Eastern Shore escape.

name: Hooper's Island Overlook
blurb: Remote Eastern Shore peninsula where the Honga River meets the Bay — wide open water views, working watermen docks, and some of the best sunsets in Maryland. Feels like the edge of the world.

name: Blackwater Falls State Park
blurb: Tannic acid turns the water deep amber-black before it plunges 57 ft — WV state park with boardwalk views and hemlock trails. The color looks unreal in photos.
